text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Several days have passed since the<n>festival in Oi.
As I approach the school<n>gates for another day of
work, I spot<n>a familiar figure.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh, so if the school gates are<n>here—Wh-whoa!
It's you again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, in the flesh. Uhhh, didn't<n>expect to get found
out like this, but<n>ya see...
choice_data_list: Would you like a campus tour?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, for real?! Yeah, I'd reallyappreciate it! Hehe... now you can seewhat it's like to show 'round the newcomer.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I'd heard the rumors, but I<n>wasn't
expecting dorms, the gym,<n>and the cafeteria to be
so gigantic...<n>even this training track is huuuge!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Guess everything really is bigger atTracen. And I'm not just talkin''bout the buildings...

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(A partner run, huh? And they're in<n>the
homestretch... right 'round the<n>time where ya figure
out when to<n>make your move.)

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Now! Hraaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Whoa, already?! It's a li'l early,<n>don'tcha think?)

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: ...No. Not yet!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Ugh, fine. In that case... I'll just outrun<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Grrraaaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
I see. Since your final spurt needs<n>work, you tried to
trick your opponent<n>into starting their spurt sooner,
thus<n>turning it into a battle of endurance.<n>Good
thinking!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's focus on increasing<n>your
stamina—both in class and on<n>your own. Now, as for
you...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on seeing through her trick!<n>You kept calm
and saved your energy<n>for the final push. Now all
we have to<n>do is refine your technique.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
With this, you both have strengths<n>you can use to
appeal to prospective<n>trainers. We'll focus on those
while<n>we prep you for the tryouts!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Okay! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Did she say tryouts? Hold on... those<n>girls haven't
made their debuts yet?!<n>Tracen students really are
on another<n>level...)

Sorry, will you be here much longer?<n>We'd like to
use this track.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. My bad, I'll get outta your<n>wa—huh?

Goodness me... Are you in the middle<n>of a tour?
Pardon us for intruding.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
N-no, I mean, ya haven't done<n>anything worth
pardonin'...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...The heck? Just who... are those<n>two? I'm
sensin'... some sorta aura<n>comin' off of 'em.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey... you know anything 'bout those<n>two?
choice_data_list: Sure. That's Oguri Cap and Super Creek.
Sure. That's Oguri Cap and Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Eager to answer any questions she<n>might have, I
explain that Oguri Cap<n>and Super Creek haven't
made their<n>debuts yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff! Huff, puff! Now it's timeto... surge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Not on my watch!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap & Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hraaaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(H-hey... wait a minute, what just<n>happened?! I
thought the grey-haired<n>girl didn't have any fight in
her, but<n>now she looks ready to tear the track<n>to
shreds!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(And the big girl... It's like she's... a<n>bottomless pit
of energy! Their race is<n>totally suckin' me in—I
can't look<n>away!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just who—or what—are they?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Inari One watches their race with<n>bated breath. I
think it's safe to say<n>their partner race has left an
impression.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You have what it takes to beat them.
You have what it takes to beat them.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Four hundred meters remain! In the<n>lead is Oguri
Cap, Oguri Cap! But<n>Super Creek's right behind her
and...<n>She takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will it be Super Creek, Oguri Cap... or<n>Inari One?
Inari One surges to the<n>front!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hraaauuugh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Only two hundred meters left! Will it<n>be Inari One or
Super Creek? The lead<n>goes to...

text_block_list.name: Inari One & Super Creek
text_block_list.text: URRRAAAUGH! HRAAAUGH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Inari One! Inari One is ahead as she...<n>crosses the
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The winner of that fiery showdown is<n>none other
than Inari One! The stands<n>greet their champion with
a roar<n>worthy of a festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(A head-to-head showdown with the<n>best of the
best... The crowd cheerin'<n>so loud, it's like
fireworks goin' off in<n>the stands. Among them
would be the<n>chief and everyone back home...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(If I could win in a place like that, I bet<n>everyone
would be smilin' as they<n>rushed the track to—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hwaugh?! Ah... Wh-what am I<n>thinkin'...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, I... I gotta get home!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: ...That girl. I had a feeling this would<n>happen...

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Nice to see ya again. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to make a small request of<n>you. Could you...
come to Oi<n>Racecourse on this day?
